input: Get a quote for loft insulation installation

gold.taskTitle: Get a loft insulation installation quote
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to obtain a price quote for having loft insulation professionally installed in their property.

questions.title: What type of property is the loft in?
questions.description: Understand whether it is a detached house, semi-detached, terraced, flat, or other property type.

questions.title: What is the approximate size of your loft?
questions.description: Gather the floor area or dimensions of the loft space to help determine the scope of work.

questions.title: Is there any existing insulation already up there?
questions.description: Find out if there is current insulation that needs topping up, replacing, or if the loft is completely bare.

questions.title: Do you prefer a specific insulation material or type?
questions.description: Determine whether the user has a preference such as mineral wool, spray foam, rigid boards, or no preference.

questions.title: Is the loft used as a living or storage space?
questions.description: Clarify whether it is a cold loft, a warm loft conversion, or a used storage area, as this affects the insulation approach.

questions.title: Do you have a target budget range in mind?
questions.description: Understand any financial constraints so quotes can be filtered or compared appropriately.

questions.title: How soon do you need the quote or work done?
questions.description: Establish the user's timeline to prioritise urgency and identify contractors with the right availability.
